Aerial Bane.p: The Aerial Bane is a Hardmode, post-Golem bow that has a 1/4 of being dropped from Betsy during Tier 3 of the Old One's Army event.

Ammo Box.p: It can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for in Hardmode.

Apprentice armor.p: The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of after defeating any Mechanical bosses|mechanical boss.

Aqua Scepter.p: The Aqua Scepter has a 1/7 chance of being obtained from the Gold Chest#Dungeon|Locked Gold Chests found in the Dungeon, as well as a 1/7 chance of being obtained from Golden Lock Boxes.

Bananarang.p: .]] The Bananarang is a Hardmode boomerang that is dropped by the Clown during Blood Moon with a 1/10 chance.

Band of Starpower.p: The Band of Starpower has a 1/5 chance of being obtained from destroying Shadow Orbs found in The Corruption or a 1/5 chance from Corrupt Crates and Defiled Crates, which are Fishing|fished in the Corruption.

Bat Scepter.p: Note the homing abilities of the bat projectiles.]] The Bat Scepter is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that is dropped by the Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon event with a 2.5–12.5% () chance depending on the current wave.<ref>Detailed drop rates in each wave: See Pumpkin Moon#Loot|Pumpkin Moon § Loot for more information.</ref> When used, it fires a burst of 2–3 homing bats, which do not pierce enemies or pass through blocks.

Betsy's Wrath.p: Betsy's Wrath is a Hardmode, post-Golem wand that has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by Betsy during Tier 3 of the Old One's Army event.

Bewitched.p: The Bewitching Table is a furniture item found naturally placed in the Dungeon and can be obtained by fishing in the Dungeon.
In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Witch Doctor for if the Wizard is present.

Blood Rain Bow.p: with Wooden Arrows.]] The Blood Rain Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow that has a 1/8 chance of being dropped by Wandering Eye Fish and Zombie Merman|Zombie Mermen.

Blood Thorn.p: It has a 1/8 chance of being dropped by Hemogoblin Sharks.

Bone Glove.p: The Bone Glove is always dropped from Skeletron's Treasure Bag#Skeletron|Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

Boomstick.p: It can be found in Ivy Chests ( chance) in the Underground Jungle, and also in Jungle Crates (19/100 chance).

Bubble Gun.p: Notice how the bubbles pop after a short time or when hitting blocks.]] The Bubble Gun is a Hardmode magic gun that has a 1/7 chance of being dropped by Duke Fishron.

Celestial Starboard.p: The Celestial Starboard is always dropped from the Moon Lord's Treasure Bag#Moon Lord|Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

Charged Blaster Cannon.p: .]] The Charged Blaster Cannon is a Hardmode, post-Golem magic gun that has a 1/800 chance to drop from all basic enemies during the Martian Madness Events|event.

Christmas Tree Sword.p: The Christmas Tree Sword is a Hardmode, post-Plantera broadsword that is dropped by the Everscream during the Frost Moon event with a 3.46%–10.37% () chance depending on the current wave.<ref>Detailed drop rates in each wave: See Frost Moon#Loot|Frost Moon § Loot for more information.</ref> When swung, it fires a star ornament that releases a ball ornament every while traveling.

Clairvoyance.p: It is purchased from the Wizard for .

Cluster Rocket I.p: It can be purchased from the Cyborg for each after completing the Martian Madness event.

Counterweight.p: on two Target Dummy|Target Dummies, one being behind the player.]] Counterweights are accessories sold by the Traveling Merchant and the Skeleton Merchant.

Daedalus Stormbow.p: The Daedalus Stormbow is a Hardmode Bows|bow that has a 1/5 chance of being dropped by Hallowed Mimics.

Dark Harvest.p: Note the chaining ability for the Dark Harvest's reaping effect, allowing it to pass through blocks and strike the three Goblin Scouts.]] The Dark Harvest is a Hardmode, post-Plantera whip that is dropped by Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon event with a 2.5–12.5% () chance depending on the current wave.<ref>Detailed drop rates in each wave: See Pumpkin Moon#Loot|Pumpkin Moon § Loot for more information.</ref> It has a 10% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:

Dark Lance.p: Note its piercing abilities.]] The Dark Lance is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron Spears|spear that has a 1/5 chance of being found in Shadow Chests in the Underworld, as well as a 1/5 chance of being found in Obsidian Lock Boxes obtained from Obsidian Crates and Hellstone Crates.

Demon Scythe.p: The Demon Scythe is a pre-Hardmode spell book that has a 1/35 chance of being dropped by Demons and Voodoo Demons.

Desert Tiger Staff.p: The Desert Tiger Staff is always found in the Dungeon's Desert Chest, which can only be unlocked with a Desert Key after Plantera has been defeated.

Eggnog.p: Eggnog is a pre-Hardmode recovery potion that can be dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event, with a chance of 8.101% in pre-Hardmode and 7.561% in Hardmode.

Electrosphere Launcher.p: Note the combining ability of the projectile, and how it can stop midair at the cursor position.]] The Electrosphere Launcher is a Hardmode, post-Golem launcher that has a 1/6 chance of being dropped by the Martian Saucer during the Martian Madness event.

Eye of the Golem.p: It has a 1/7 chance of being dropped by Golem.

Feral Claws.p: Feral Claws are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Jungle Crates, Bramble Crates, and Ivy Chests located in Jungle Shrines and at the base of a Living Mahogany Tree in the Underground Jungle.

Firecracker.p: Note how the blazing energy explodes upon minion hits, multiplying their damage.]] The Firecracker is a Hardmode whip that has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by the Wall of Flesh.

Flintlock Pistol.p: .]] The Flintlock Pistol is a pre-Hardmode gun that can be bought from the Arms Dealer for .

Flying Dragon.p: Notice how the projectile pierces walls and four dummies, dissipating upon hitting the fifth.]] The Flying Dragon is a Hardmode, post-Golem broadsword that has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by Betsy during Tier 3 of the Old One's Army event.

Gi.p: It is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for .

Gladiator armor.p: Each piece has a 1/21 chance of being dropped by Hoplites.

Gold armor.p: The Ancient Gold Helmet has a 1/100 chance of being dropped by Skeletons and Spore Skeletons, and can also be obtained by dropping a Gold Helmet into Shimmer.

Hive Pack.p: The Hive Pack is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Queen Bee's Treasure Bag#Queen Bee|Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

Houndius Shootius.p: The Houndius Shootius has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by Deerclops.

Kaleidoscope.p: and a Shark, alongside a Flinx Staff minion.]] The Kaleidoscope is a Hardmode, post-Plantera whip that has a 1/4 chance of being dropped by the Empress of Light.

Leather Whip.p: and a Harpy, alongside a Slime Staff minion.]] The Leather Whip is a pre-Hardmode whip that is virtually always available to be purchased from the Zoologist for (save for #Notes|certain scenarios).

Lunar Portal Staff.p: The Lunar Portal Staff has a 1/5 chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord.

Magic Hat.p: It is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for .

Magic Quiver.p: It has a 1/40 chance of being dropped from Skeleton Archers.

Magma Stone.p: It has a 1/50 chance to be dropped by Lava Bats and a 1/150 chance to be dropped by Hellbats in The Underworld.

Meowmere.p: The Meowmere is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/5 chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord.

Monk armor.p: The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of after defeating any Mechanical bosses|mechanical boss.

Moon Stone.p: The Moon Stone is a Hardmode accessory which has a 1/35 / chance to drop from Vampires during the Solar Eclipse event.

Morning Star.p: and a Unicorn, alongside a Trusty Cattiva minion.]] The Morning Star is a Hardmode, post-Plantera whip that has a 1/200 / {{expert|}} chance of being dropped by Blue Armored Bones, Rusty Armored Bones, and Hell Armored Bones in the Hardmode Dungeon.

Musket Ball.p: Musket Balls can be bought from the Arms Dealer for each, or for 1000 rounds.
They can also be obtained from Shadow Orbs and Crimson Hearts (along with a Musket or The Undertaker), or from a Present (along with a Red Ryder) during Christmas.

Mystic Robe.p: It is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for .

Necro armor.p: The Ancient Necro Helmet is dropped from Angry Bones, Dark Casters, and Librarian Skeletons in the Dungeon, at a 1/450 chance.

Nimbus Rod.p: The Nimbus Rod has a 1/15 chance of being dropped by Angry Nimbuses.

Paintball Gun.p: It has a 1/10 chance of being dropped by the Painter.

Phantom Phoenix.p: The Phantom Phoenix also Ammo conversion|converts Wooden Arrows into Flaming Arrows, without increasing their damage.<ref name="aistyle75"/> The Phantom Phoenix is dropped by Ogres during the Old One's Army event, with a 1/10 / chance during Tier 2, and a 1/20 chance during Tier 3.

Pygmy Necklace.p: It is purchased from the Witch Doctor for at night.

Rainbow Crystal Staff.p: The Rainbow Crystal Staff has a 1/5 chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord.

Rainbow Gun.p: The Rainbow Gun is always found in the Dungeon's Hallowed Chest, which can only be unlocked with a Hallowed Key after Plantera has been defeated.

Ranger Emblem.p: It has a 1/4 chance to drop from the Wall of Flesh.

Raven Staff.p: The Raven Staff is dropped by the Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon event with a 2.5–12.5% () chance depending on the current wave.<ref>Detailed drop rates in each wave: See Pumpkin Moon#Loot|Pumpkin Moon § Loot for more information.</ref>

Razorpine.p: Note how the projectiles dissipate upon contact with a surface.]] The Razorpine is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that is dropped by the Everscream during the Frost Moon Events|event with a 3.46%–10.37% () chance depending on the current wave.<ref>Detailed drop rates in each wave: See Frost Moon#Loot|Frost Moon § Loot for more information.</ref> When used, it rapidly fires 2–4 high-velocity pine needles in a spread, which do not pierce enemies or pass through blocks.

Rocket III.p: Rockets are a Hardmode, post-Plantera type of ammunition which are mainly sold by the Cyborg.
The Rocket I variant is also dropped by Plantera when it drops the Grenade Launcher.

Rod of Discord.p: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 / chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals.
It can be upgraded into the Rod of Harmony by throwing it into Shimmer after the Moon Lord has been defeated.

Rod of Harmony.p: It is obtained by throwing the Rod of Discord into Shimmer after the Moon Lord has been defeated.

Shadowflame Hex Doll.p: The Shadowflame Hex Doll has a 1/6 / chance to drop from Goblin Warlocks during a Hardmode Goblin Army.

Shadowflame Knife.p: The Shadowflame Knife is a Hardmode melee weapon that has a 1/6 / chance to drop from Goblin Warlocks during the Goblin Army event.

Shark Tooth Necklace.p: The Shark Tooth Necklace is an accessory which has a 1/150 / chance to drop from Blood Zombies and Dripplers found during a Blood Moon.

Sharpened.p: In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Merchant for .

Shield of Cthulhu.p: .]] The Shield of Cthulhu is a pre-Hardmode shield accessory that is always dropped from the Eye of Cthulhu's Treasure Bag#Eye of Cthulhu|Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

Shinobi Infiltrator armor.p: The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of .

Snowman Cannon.p: s.]] The Snowman Cannon is a Hardmode, post-Plantera launcher that is dropped from the Ice Queen during the Frost Moon event with a 5.19%–10.37% () chance depending on the current wave.<ref>Detailed drop rates in each wave: See Frost Moon#Loot|Frost Moon § Loot for more information.</ref>.

Soaring Insignia.p: The Soaring Insignia is always dropped from the Empress of Light's Treasure Bag#Empress of Light|Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

Sorcerer Emblem.p: It has a 1/4 chance to drop from the Wall of Flesh.

Squire armor.p: The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of after defeating any Mechanical bosses|mechanical boss.

Staff of the Frost Hydra.p: The Staff of the Frost Hydra is always found in the Dungeon's Ice Chest, which can only be unlocked with a Frozen Key after Plantera has been defeated.

Stellar Tune.p: The Stellar Tune has a 1/50 / chance of being dropped by the Empress of Light.

Strange Brew.p: The Strange Brew is a pre-Hardmode recovery potion that can be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant during certain moon phases for .

Stynger.p: The Stynger has a 1/7 chance of being dropped by Golem.
Additional Stynger Bolts can be purchased from the Witch Doctor and Arms Dealer ( per bolt), if the Stynger is in the player's inventory.

Thunder Zapper.p: The Thunder Zapper is a pre-Hardmode wand that can be found in Sandstone Chests in the lower 3/7ths of the Underground Desert and in Oasis Crates and Mirage Crates obtained from fishing in the Oasis.

Tiki armor.p: The set can be purchased from the Witch Doctor for a total of .

Tungsten Bullet.p: Tungsten Bullets can be bought from the Arms Dealer for each, or for 1000 rounds in worlds with Tungsten Ore|Tungsten.
During pre-Hardmode, they are only sold during Blood Moons.

Unholy Trident.p: The Unholy Trident has a 1/30 chance of being dropped by Red Devils.

Uzi.p: .]] The Uzi is a Hardmode gun that has a 1/100 chance of being dropped by Angry Trappers.

Valhalla Knight armor.p: The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of .

Vampire Knives.p: The Vampire Knives are always found in the Dungeon's Crimson Chest, which can only be unlocked with a Crimson Key after Plantera has been defeated.

Wasp Gun.p: Note how the projectiles home in on the Mimic and ricochet off of blocks.]] The Wasp Gun is a Hardmode magic gun that has a 1/8 chance of being dropped by Plantera.

Wizard Hat.p: It is always dropped by Tim.

Xeno Staff.p: The Xeno Staff has a 1/6 chance of being dropped by the Martian Saucer during the Martian Madness event.

Xenopopper.p: The Xenopopper is a Hardmode, post-Golem gun that has a 1/6 chance of being dropped by the Martian Saucer during the Martian Madness event.

Meteorite.p: It also spawns in high numbers during a Meteor Shower and rarely drops from Meteor Heads.

Snow Block.p: Snow blocks are also dropped by the Hardmode Frost Legion enemies, and its Snow Balla throws Snowballs that create further Snow blocks when impacting.

Hallowed Bar.p: It is dropped by all three mechanical bosses: The Twins, The Destroyer, and Skeletron Prime.

Life Crystal.p: Life Crystals also have a 1/8 chance to drop from a Golden Crate, or 19/160 chance from a Titanium Crate.

Ectoplasm.p: Ectoplasm is a Hardmode, post-Plantera crafting material dropped from Dungeon Spirits in the Dungeon.

Luminite.p: Luminite is a Hardmode ore dropped by the Moon Lord in stacks of 70–90 ().

Titanium Ore.p: As with all early Hardmode ores, decreasing quantities of the ore spawn with every third altar broken afterwards, it is immune to Explosives (class)|explosives (apart from the Power Bomb and Sticky Power Bomb), and it can be obtained from Hardmode crates.

Antlion Mandible.p: The Antlion Mandible is a crafting material dropped by Antlions, Antlion Larvae, Antlion Chargers, and Antlion Swarmers found in the Desert and Underground Desert biomes.

Bee Wax.p: Bee Wax is a crafting material dropped by the Queen Bee.

Black Lens.p: The Black Lens is a crafting material dropped by Demon Eyes and Wandering Eyes at a 1/100 chance.

Bone.p: They are dropped by Angry Bones, Dark Casters, Cursed Skulls, and Librarian Skeletons which spawn in the Dungeon.

Cloud.p: Cloud is a type of block found beneath Floating Islands, along with Rain Cloud blocks; on the , they can be found in stacks in Skyware Chests, Sky Crates and Azure Crates as well.

Crystal Shard.p: Crystal Shards furthermore have a 1/2 chance to be obtained from Divine Crates, in stacks of 4–10.

Cursed Flame.p: It is dropped by World Feeders, Vile Ghouls and Clingers, all of which can be found in The Corruption.
It can also be found in Defiled Crates.

Feather.p: The Feather is a common crafting material dropped frequently by Harpy|Harpies.

Gel.p: Gel is a common crafting material dropped by most slimes and Zombie|Slimed Zombies.

Ichor.p: Ichor is a Hardmode crafting material dropped by Ichor Stickers in the Underground Crimson and the Tainted Ghoul in the The Crimson|Crimson Underground Desert.
It is also obtained from Hematic Crates.

Lens.p: A Lens is a common crafting material that has a 33/100 chance to drop from Demon Eyes and Wandering Eyes.

Nebula Fragment.p: It is one of the four Lunar Fragments, dropped from the Nebula Pillar during the Lunar Events in stacks of 12–60 / .

Pixie Dust.p: Pixie Dust is a common Hardmode crafting material that always drops from Pixies.

Rotten Chunk.p: The Rotten Chunk is a crafting material that has a 1/3 chance of being dropped from Eater of Souls|Eaters of Souls, Devourers, Corruptors, and on the , the Eater of Worlds.

Shadow Scale.p: The Shadow Scale is a pre-Hardmode crafting material dropped from the Eater of Worlds (and its Treasure Bag in Expert Mode).

Shark Fin.p: The Shark Fin is a crafting material that has a 19/20 chance of being dropped by Sharks and Orcas found in the Ocean biome, and a 1/8 chance of being dropped by Sand Sharks during a Sandstorm.

Solar Fragment.p: It is one of the four Lunar Fragments, dropped from the Solar Pillar during the Lunar Events in stacks of 12–60 / .

Soul of Flight.p: Souls of Flight are dropped by Wyverns and are the most common soul aside from the Soul of Light|Souls of Light and Soul of Night|Night.

Soul of Fright.p: It is a crafting material dropped by Skeletron Prime.

Soul of Light.p: Soul of Light is a Hardmode Crafting materials|crafting material dropped by most enemies killed in the Underground Hallow in the Cavern layer or The Underworld at a 1/5 chance.

Soul of Might.p: It is a crafting material dropped by The Destroyer.

Soul of Night.p: Soul of Night is a Hardmode Crafting materials|crafting material dropped by most enemies killed in the Underground Corruption or Underground Crimson biome in the Cavern layer or The Underworld at a 1/5 chance.

Soul of Sight.p: It is a crafting material dropped by The Twins.

Spider Fang.p: The Spider Fang is a Hardmode crafting material dropped by Black Recluses in Spider Nests with a 1/2 / chance.

Stardust Fragment.p: It is one of the four Lunar Fragments, dropped from the Stardust Pillar during the Lunar Events in stacks of 12–60 / .

Stinger.p: It is obtained from Spiked Jungle Slimes, Hornets, and Moss Hornets found in the Underground Jungle biome.

Tissue Sample.p: The Tissue Sample is a pre-Hardmode crafting material dropped from Creepers (and the Brain of Cthulhu's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode).

Unicorn Horn.p: The Unicorn Horn is a Hardmode crafting material that is always dropped by Unicorns in The Hallow.

Vertebra.p: The Vertebra (Vertebrae ) is a crafting material that has a 1/3 chance of being dropped by Crimeras, Blood Crawlers, Face Monsters, Floaty Grosses.

Vine.p: Vines are crafting materials dropped by Man Eaters in the Underground Jungle biome with a 1/2 / drop chance.

Vortex Fragment.p: It is one of the four Lunar Fragments, dropped from the Vortex Pillar during the Lunar Events in stacks of 12–60 / .

Demonite Ore.p: It is primarily dropped from the Eater of Worlds, as well as the Eye of Cthulhu in Corruption worlds.

Crimtane Ore.p: It is primarily dropped from the Brain of Cthulhu, as well as the Eye of Cthulhu in Crimson worlds.
